'''Ross Anan''' is Jasfer and [[Setalle Anan]]'s youngest son. He has three sisters and at least one older brother.

He is normally helping his father on his fishing boat or his mother in the [[The Wandering Woman]].

He mocks his eldest sister [[Marah Anan|Marah]], because his other sister, [[Frielle]], is younger than Marah and already married while she is not.
